meta_title: Crypto Payments for E-commerce Stores | DynoPay
meta_description: Accept crypto payments for e-commerce stores. Bitcoin, Ethereum, USDT, Solana + 15 cryptos. No chargebacks. Funds go direct to your wallet. Start free.
h1: Accept crypto payments for e-commerce stores without chargebacks
subheading: Receive Bitcoin, Ethereum, stablecoins, and 15+ cryptocurrencies directly to your wallet. No payment holds, no fraud disputes, no 2-4% processor fees.
intro_paragraph: E-commerce merchants lose 0.47% of revenue to chargebacks and another 2.9% + $0.30 per card transaction. DynoPay is a non-custodial crypto commerce platform built for online stores: you receive funds directly in your own wallet the moment a customer pays, eliminating chargeback risk entirely. Pricing starts at 1.5% and drops to 0.5% at scale based on volume, with no monthly fees, no setup costs, and your first payment is completely free.

features.title: Zero chargeback risk, ever
features.description: Crypto transactions are final. No fraud disputes, no friendly fraud, no representment fees. Once a customer pays Bitcoin, USDT, or ETH, the funds are yours and cannot be reversed by a bank.

features.title: Funds arrive in your wallet
features.description: DynoPay never holds your money. Payments settle directly to your Ethereum address, Bitcoin wallet, or Solana account within minutes. You control the private keys and custody at all times.

features.title: Lower fees than card processors
features.description: Pay from 1.5% and watch fees drop automatically to 0.5% as your volume grows. No interchange, no basis points on refunds, no monthly gateway charges. First payment is free.

how_it_works: Sign up, verify your email, and create a company profile in under three minutes.
Add one payout wallet address for Bitcoin, Ethereum, USDT, or any supported crypto you want to accept.
Generate a payment link or embed the checkout widget on your Shopify, WooCommerce, or custom store. Go live.

faqs.question: What cryptocurrencies can my e-commerce store accept with DynoPay?
faqs.answer: DynoPay supports 15+ cryptocurrencies including Bitcoin, Ethereum, Litecoin, Dogecoin, Solana, XRP, and stablecoins like USDT on Ethereum, Tron, and Polygon, USDC on Ethereum, and RLUSD on Ethereum and XRP Ledger. You choose which to enable.

faqs.question: Do I need a crypto wallet to accept payments?
faqs.answer: Yes. DynoPay is non-custodial, so you provide one wallet address per cryptocurrency you want to accept. Payments go directly there. You control the private keys. DynoPay never holds customer funds or requires you to withdraw.

faqs.question: How much does DynoPay charge per transaction?
faqs.answer: Pricing starts at 1.5% plus one dollar per successful payment and drops automatically to 0.5% as your settled volume increases. No monthly fees, no setup costs, no hidden charges. Your first payment is completely fee-free.

faqs.question: Can customers dispute or reverse a crypto payment?
faqs.answer: No. Cryptocurrency transactions are irreversible by design. Once a customer sends Bitcoin or USDT and the blockchain confirms it, the payment cannot be charged back, disputed, or clawed back by a bank or card network.

faqs.question: How long does it take to start accepting crypto on my online store?
faqs.answer: Most merchants go live in under 10 minutes. Sign up, verify your email, add a company profile, connect one wallet address, then generate a payment link or drop the widget into your storefront. No underwriting or waiting period.

cta_body: Your first payment is free and setup takes less than 10 minutes. No monthly fees, no chargebacks, funds direct to your wallet.
